# Warlock AI Deepseek

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-deepseek`

> DeepSeek adapter for @warlock.js/ai

## Skills

- [ai-deepseek](@warlock.js/ai-deepseek/skills/SKILL.md): DeepSeek adapter for Warlock AI: `DeepSeekSDK`, `DEEPSEEK_CHAT_MODELS`, `DEEPSEEK_DEFAULT_PRICING` and `DEEPSEEK_OFF_PEAK_PRICING`. Use for "connect DeepSeek", reasoning, streaming, tools, capability inference or per-model pricing through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents, tools and workflows; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
